status: PROPOSAL applying the owner's materiality standard. Pending owner confirmation. Not part of the original gold set.
note: Original labels are preserved: corpus/ and fixtures/ are untouched and the original 26-risk benchmark is scored exactly as before. Only three documents are labelled benign (clean-document, library-volunteer-agreement, swim-lesson-registration). Every sentence in them was read against the standard. library-volunteer-agreement has no term that forfeits money, a service or property, so it has no correction. Sentences listed in the same document as ordinary payments (the $45 fee, the $120 fee, the fifteen-dollar refund for a cancelled lesson) are left as the gold set labels them. Freeze this file before scoring a candidate: its SHA-256 is recorded in README.md.

corrections.sentence: Where the Plot Holder gives notice, no refund is due, and the Plot Holder may harvest whatever is ready before the notice period runs out.
corrections.originalLabel: benign: the document is labelled clean, so any flag on it is counted as a false alarm
corrections.correctedLabel: valid low forfeiture: a flag here is correct under the standard
corrections.standard: PRD.md materiality paragraph (Option B, 2026-11-11): a payment becomes a flag when the text adds a downside such as forfeiting money for a period or service the signer won't get; ordinary payments (no refund for a period already had or still usable) are not flags. Severity is judged separately, and a small, bounded forfeiture is Low.
corrections.reason: The prepaid season fee is not refunded for the months left after the Plot Holder gives notice, so the money pays for a period the signer will not get. The Association's own notice triggers a pro-rata refund in the sentence before it, so the loss only falls on the signer's exit.
